name: team game implied team total splits by week under a week row axis (executed-result parity)
description: Seed a player on team ZUA with DraftKings CLOSE spread and total markets on ZUA's 2023 REG week 1 game (spread -3.5, total 44.5 -> implied 24.0) and on its week 2 game (spread -7.5, total 51.5 -> implied 29.5), then request the column with single_nfl_week_id naming BOTH weeks under a year+week row axis. Each week row must carry its own week's implied total. team_game_implied_team_total_with filtered both the spread and the total CTE on a single scalar nfl_games.week and team_game_implied_team_total_join correlated on team alone, so week 1's implied total rendered on every week row. The oracle values are computed from the seed as (total - spread) / 2, not read from output. The player maps to the spread market's selection_pid through player_year_teams (gamelog rows seed team ZUA for 2023), so the joined team is that of the row's year, not the current roster.
expected_query:

game_count DESC, nfl_team ASC))[1] as team from (select "player_gamelogs"."pid", "nfl_games"."season_year" as "year", "player_gamelogs"."nfl_team", count(*) as "game_count" from "player_gamelogs" inner join "nfl_games" on "nfl_games"."esbid" = "player_gamelogs"."esbid" where "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2023) and "player_gamelogs"."season_year" in (2023) group by "player_gamelogs"."pid", "nfl_games"."season_year", "player_gamelogs"."nfl_team") as "player_year_team_counts" group by "pid", "year"), "t291bf0eba9c9f524f5b2d85079159db2_spread" as "prop_markets_index"."source_id" and "pms"."source_market_id" = "prop_markets_index"."source_market_id" and "pms"."time_type" = "prop_markets_index"."time_type" inner join "nfl_games" on "nfl_games"."esbid" = "prop_markets_index"."esbid" and "nfl_games"."season_year" = "prop_markets_index"."season_year" where "market_type" = 'GAME_TOTAL' and "prop_markets_index"."time_type" = 'CLOSE' and "prop_markets_index"."source_id" = 'DRAFTKINGS' and "prop_markets_index"."season_year" in (2023) and "nfl_games"."nfl_week_id" in ('2023_REG_WEEK_1', '2023_REG_WEEK_2') order by "pms"."selection_pid" asc, "prop_markets_index"."esbid" asc, "pms"."observed_at" desc, "prop_markets_index"."source_market_id" asc), "t291bf0eba9c9f524f5b2d85079159db2" as (select "s"."esbid", "s"."selection_pid", "s"."year", "s"."week", (t.total - s.spread) / 2 as implied_team_total from "t291bf0eba9c9f524f5b2d85079159db2_spread" as "s" inner join "t291bf0eba9c9f524f5b2d85079159db2_total" as "t" on "s"."esbid" = "t"."esbid"), "player_participation_weeks" as (SELECT pid, year, week, bool_or(is_active) AS is_active
          FROM (SELECT pgl.pid, 2023::int AS year, g.week, pgl.is_active
       FROM player_gamelogs_year_2023 pgl
       INNER JOIN nfl_games g ON g.esbid = pgl.esbid
       WHERE g.season_type = 'REG' AND g.season_year = 2023) src
          GROUP BY pid, year, week), "player_years_teams" as (SELECT pid, year, array_agg(DISTINCT team_code) AS teams
          FROM (SELECT pgl.pid, 2023::int AS year, pgl.nfl_team AS team_code
       FROM player_gamelogs_year_2023 pgl
       INNER JOIN nfl_games g ON g.esbid = pgl.esbid
       WHERE g.season_type = 'REG' AND g.season_year = 2023) src
          GROUP BY pid, year), "team_weeks_played" as (select distinct "team", "year", "week" from ((select "home_nfl_team" as "team", "season_year" as "year", "week" from "nfl_games" where "nfl_games"."nfl_week_id" in ('2023_REG_WEEK_1', '2023_REG_WEEK_2') and "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2023)) union all (select "away_nfl_team" as "team", "season_year" as "year", "week" from "nfl_games" where "nfl_games"."nfl_week_id" in ('2023_REG_WEEK_1', '2023_REG_WEEK_2') and "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2023))) as "g") select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, "t291bf0eba9c9f524f5b2d85079159db2"."implied_team_total" AS "team_game_implied_team_total_betting_market_0", "player_years_weeks"."year", "player_years_weeks"."week", CASE
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.is_active THEN 'active'
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.pid IS NULL
          AND player_years_teams.teams IS NOT NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM team_weeks_played
            WHERE team_weeks_played.year = player_years_weeks.year
              AND team_weeks_played.week = player_years_weeks.week
              AND team_weeks_played.team = ANY(player_years_teams.teams)
          )
       THEN 'bye'
     ELSE NULL
   END AS participation_status, "player"."primary_position" from "player" inner join "player_years_weeks" on "player_years_weeks"."pid" = "player"."pid" left join "player_year_teams" on "player_year_teams"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_year_teams"."year" = "player_years_weeks"."year" left join "t291bf0eba9c9f524f5b2d85079159db2" on "t291bf0eba9c9f524f5b2d85079159db2"."selection_pid" = "player_year_teams"."team" and t291bf0eba9c9f524f5b2d85079159db2.year = player_years_weeks.year and t291bf0eba9c9f524f5b2d85079159db2.week = player_years_weeks.week left join "player_participation_weeks" on "player_participation_weeks"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_participation_weeks"."year" = "player_years_weeks"."year" and "player_participation_weeks"."week" = "player_years_weeks"."week" left join "player_years_teams" on "player_years_teams"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_years_teams"."year" = "player_years_weeks"."year" where player.primary_position IN ('MLB') group by player.first_name, player.last_name, "t291bf0eba9c9f524f5b2d85079159db2"."implied_team_total", "player_years_weeks"."year", "player_years_weeks"."week", CASE
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.is_active THEN 'active'
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.pid IS NULL
          AND player_years_teams.teams IS NOT NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM team_weeks_played
            WHERE team_weeks_played.year = player_years_weeks.year
              AND team_weeks_played.week = player_years_weeks.week
              AND team_weeks_played.team = ANY(player_years_teams.teams)
          )
       THEN 'bye'
     ELSE NULL
   END, "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by "player"."pid" asc limit 500
